course.title: Visual Studio Code — Complete Deep Developer Tools Course
course.description: A Visual Studio Code-specific, beginner-to-advanced course with detailed concepts, practical workflows, dedicated tasks, troubleshooting, security and a production learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn the tool properly; no fixed cross-tool template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Use the tool confidently in professional development.
Complete a production-style developer workflow capstone.

modules.title: VS Code Foundations
modules.description: Editor interface, files, folders, workspace concepts and command palette.

lessons.title: VS Code Foundations
lessons.description: Editor interface, files, folders, workspace concepts and command palette.
learningObjectives: Apply it to a realistic development workflow.

notes.text: Editor interface, files, folders, workspace concepts and command palette.
Learn vs code foundations by understanding the developer problem first, then the tool concept, then a realistic command/editor workflow, and finally how it fits into professional development.

VS Code Foundations is a practical part of a modern development workflow. Students should understand not only the command or editor feature, but also why it is used, what it changes, how to verify it and how to recover from mistakes.
